project.title: Illumina bulk metagenomic sequencing of the sewage microbiome from the same sampling point as the single-cell genomics experiment
project.description: This study presents raw paired-end Illumina bulk metagenomic sequencing reads generated from the same original sewage sample used for the droplet-based microbial single-cell genomic sequencing dataset. The dataset provides metagenomic information for the sewage microbiome.

samples: environmental sample; urban association not established
